name: autolabel
description: GitHub Action that labels pull requests based on conventional commit PR titles

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --minify --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.all: npm run check:node && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run lint:fix && npm run format
